close_reason: Already defended: mailbox.rs:712-731 has extensive comments explaining the two-pass strategy and role-swap correctness invariants.
description: The two-pass update loop in handle_mailbox_set (vacating patches first, claiming patches second) is genuinely correct and non-trivial. It allows a client to atomically swap roles across mailboxes in a single request regardless of map iteration order. A naive single-pass would fail for the swap case (both A→null and B→'inbox' in the same request) because the role-taken check would see A still holding inbox during B's claim. The implementation correctly tracks roles_actually_vacated only from successful pass-1 updates, so a failed vacate does not erroneously free the role. A contributor might suggest simplifying to a single pass — do not do it.
title: Mailbox/set two-pass role-swap correctly handles atomic role transitions within one request
